notes: Verified in source and by running: default is off (existing mcp rows decode with OAuth zero value; integration test asserts 404 metadata, bare 401 and ignored JWT while off).

Ran the full Go suite against a scratch Postgres (APPSTORE_TEST_POSTGRES_DSN set): all packages pass including TestPostgreSQLMCPOAuthIntegration; the log line with error=/issuer=/request_id= is emitted for every refusal, so the missing piece is only the test that pins it. go vet clean. web: vitest mcp-oauth.test.tsx 5/5, tsc and eslint clean on the changed files.

Rejection paths exercised with a real fake IdP (RSA JWKS over httptest): expired, nbf in future, other issuer, typ ID (header and claim), HS256, cnf-bound, no sub, unknown subject (no account created, user count unchanged), inactive account, other audience, valid token on REST (/api/v1/me → 401).

Empty scope intersection (campaign rule 3) checked in internal/mcp/tools.go:75,103 and internal/mcp/server.go:24: an authenticated caller with an empty Permissions map gets no tools and cannot call any; empty never means unrestricted. oauthPermissions never emits '*'.

Only new unauthenticated routes are /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource[/*] (RFC 9728), which return 404 unless active and expose only resource, issuer, scope names and site name — no secrets. Refusal messages carry the token's aud/azp and the resource identifier only; logs carry err and issuer, never the token.
No migrations: settings live in the existing mcp JSON row; reverting the code leaves an ignored 'oauth' key. PDFs regenerated alongside the guides is the repo convention (see 17b8560).

Non-blocking observations: (a) AccessTokenVerifier.provider holds the mutex across the 15s discovery round trip, so while the issuer is unreachable JWT-bearing /mcp requests serialize (key callers are unaffected); (b) resolveMCPOAuth only requires oidc.issuer_url, not oidc.enabled — disabling web SSO leaves MCP tokens accepted until mcp.oauth.enabled is also turned off (documented as 'reuse'); (c) the Host-header fallback for the resource identifier can only be reached by clearing the service URL after enabling, since adminUpdateMCP validates with r=nil.
Scope of the diff matches the commit message; the analytics_handlers.go one-liner just classifies /.well-known/ as a machine path.
